messages:
mira: :rotating_light: prod/inference-latency-service spiking to 500/503s across eu-west. Incidentbot did not page the oncall. Seeing repeated alerts in alertd. Anyone oncall?
ops-bot: [automated] Alert created INC-4821 for prod/inference-latency-service. delivery_status=SUPPRESSED reason=webhook-flagged rate_limit=10m
alex: I was oncall earlier, didn't get a phone page. only slack notif in #incidents was the bot message above.
oncall-sre: i'm oncall ✅. confirming no page on my side either. checking alertd logs now.
samir: I can jump into mitigation — are errors internal 5xx or upstream 502? any customer reports?
elena: customer-impact: observed ~12 tenants with 20-30% failed requests, retries are causing latency spikes. UI errors for a small subset of heavy-sequence requests.
ops-bot: [automated] alertd logs snippet: "signature_verification=failed token=rotated webhook_id=alert-bridge-7" — suppression flag set by webhook-fallback policy.
alex: that sounds like a signing rotation. We rotated alert-bridge token yesterday during deploy window. alertd should have loaded new secret but apparently didn't.
samir: interim mitigation: manually trigger phone pages and enable backup routing. @oncall-sre can you accept phone handoff?
oncall-sre: accepted phone handoff. manually paging now: /page-oncall prod 2 :phone:
elena: also pushing temporary routing rule to force fallback model endpoint (lower throughput) to reduce 5xxs. informing CS for affected tenants.
alex: I'm going to restart the alertd webhook worker on prod to pick up rotated secret: runbook command: ```kubectl -n alert-system rollout restart deployment/alertd-webhook-worker```
ops-bot: [automated] deploy-bot started rollout for alertd-webhook-worker. tracking: rollout_id=rb-9832
deploy-bot: [automated] rollout in progress. If restart fails, use curl to re-register webhook: ```curl -X POST https://internal-config/api/webhooks/register -H 'Authorization: Bearer <ADMIN_TOKEN>' -d '{"id":"alert-bridge-7","secret":"<new-secret>"}'```
oncall-sre: restart completed, alertd logs now show signature_verification=ok. re-enabling normal paging route.
mira: :white_check_mark: good — incidentbot should resume automatic pages. Samir please keep an eye on error rate for the next 15m.
samir: watching. error rate trending down after fallback routing, now ~5% over baseline. will open a follow-up ticket for root cause analysis and stricter deploy-time validation.
elena: filed INC-4821-POSTMORTEM and linked tenants list + customer comms draft. tagging support.
alex: action items: (1) add secret-load healthcheck to alertd (2) revert risky token rotation in deploy pipeline to staged step (3) postmortem + blameless RCA. assigning to eng-oncall and infra.
oncall-sre: noted. I'll add a high-priority JIRA and set a standup at +10m.
mira: thanks all. marking incident as mitigated for now. will move to postmortem channel once we have logs and timeline. :thumbsup:
